originalReportedCause: Owner-local TypeScript configuration could not resolve the canonical application source graph.
verifiedCurrentCause: The owner-local config extended the base aliases but included every TypeScript file, pulling non-runtime audit and browser scripts into the Next production compile; stale dev and production generated route types could also conflict.
remediation: Owner-local includes the same production application graph as tsconfig.next.json: app, components, data, lib, types, proxy and Next config.
Strict mode and the @/* path alias remain inherited from tsconfig.json.
Tests and operational audit scripts were not reclassified as production application source.
Only production owner-local generated route types are included; stale dev generated types are excluded and cleaned.

whyPreviousGatesMissedIt.ownerLocalStructuralTest: Validated source strings and child environment, not a real Next compile.
